title.en: Appointment of Registrar and Deputy Registrar of Manufacturers

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Control of Manufacture Act
(Chapter 57, Section 4)
Appointment of Registrar and Deputy Registrar of Manufacturers
N 1
G.N. No. S 605/1990
REVISED EDITION 1990
(25th March 1992)
[1st February 1990]
The Minister of State charged with the responsibility of the Minister for Trade and Industry has appointed —
(a)the Chairman of the Economic Development Board to be the Registrar of Manufacturers; and
(b)the Chief Executive Officer of the Economic Development Board to be the Deputy Registrar of Manufacturers.
